name: ACDPlay
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 2.04 or later and a supported SCSI/ATAPI CD-ROM device
notes: The installed executable matches the pinned ACDPlay 1.6 archive; the icon retains the checked BCWB replacement and its stock tooltypes.
BCWB tooltypes include DEVICE=scsi.device, UNIT=1, AUTOSTART=NO, DISKPATH=PROGDIR:Disks and the literal CX_POPOKEY spelling.
Stock contains no ACDPlay guide, catalogs, Disks drawer, ARexx scripts or ENV/ENVARC acdplay.cfg. These upstream extras are not installed.
The 1.6 guide states that internal SCSI routines replaced cdplay.library; its remaining installer text is stale. No cdplay.library is installed.
